title: Speak No Evil
subtitle: (remake)
review: Similar to {The Grudge} remake, it doesn't really need to exist, but that doesn't mean it's bad. I liked all the performances, and the filmography and lighting, and I especially liked the location. Some unique parts were great, like the thatched roof bit, and James McAvoy's last shot. But remaking a film so quickly, and keeping so much the same, does feel like a bit of a waste. Changing the ending was a good idea, in that I was able to watch this, having seen the original twice, and still be surprised by it. However the ending of the original is the most memorable and important part, and the same heights aren't reached here. It really is good, but it'll always be second best to me.
